routes.label: Scale the cost of one third of the CDs

question: Brianna is using part of the money she earned on her weekend job to buy several equally-priced CDs. She used one fifth of her money to buy one third of the CDs. What fraction of her money will she have left after she buys all the CDs?
solution:
Because the CDs all have the same price, three groups containing the same number of CDs have the same cost. One third of the CDs costs \(\frac15\) of Brianna's money, so all three thirds cost
\[
3\cdot\frac15=\frac35
\]
of her money. The fraction left is therefore
\[
1-\frac35=\boxed{\frac25},
\]
choice \(\text{C}\).

edges.reason: Adding equal-denominator parts uses the meaning of one such unit fraction and a count of equally sized parts.
A general fraction takes several equal unit parts; one such part is the unit-fraction concept directly contained in that construction.
edges.scope: fraction as a count of unit fractional parts

edges.reason: The prerequisite explicitly limits same-denominator arithmetic to results at most one. Repeated equal-fraction addition supplies a valid derivation only within that range; a nonnegative repeated sum has all intermediate sums within the same bound. Gemini notes this restriction. Narrow the proposed scope instead of attributing general improper-fraction multiplication to the elementary endpoint.
edges.scope: Deriving a fraction-times-positive-integer product by repeated addition when the product is at most one

edges.reason: The target explicitly reduces its final product to simplest form, directly using fraction reduction.
edges.scope: reducing the product to simplest form

edges.reason: Contexts such as price, quantity and total, or speed, time and distance, supply familiar examples. Direct proportion can be learned through other contexts like side length and perimeter.
Direct proportion rests on a constant ratio value, which is ratio meaning. Proportion equations matter only when problems are solved by setting up a proportion.

The criteria identify an invariant ratio and use its value to find the other quantity. This requires the quotient meaning of a ratio, without the additional cross-product property of proportions. Root checked both endpoint-based reviews; each identifies the stated content or conditional method rather than a curriculum-order claim.
edges.scope: Interpreting the constant ratio and using its value in direct proportion
